messages.author: 2f3428d3166aad1c
messages.subject: option for shiny to not ignore hidden elements
parts: This is a more general question possibly regarding my previous problem, but something I am having trouble with in other areas as well.  There are several cases in my apps where I need to compute something in R and then make it available to javascript code, but I don't want it to show up anywhere on the page.  I do this by creating hidden reactive outputs (what I'm actually doing is pretty complex and I can't come up with a simple example off the top of my head).  These do not update anymore with the current shiny version.  Is there a way to turn off the ignoring of hidden reactive UI elements?

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: option for shiny to not ignore hidden elements
parts:
In your call to shinyServer(), you can tell it to not suspend a particular object when hidden. For example, if your object is output$x, you'd do something like this:

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$x <- renderText({ ... })

  outputOptions(output, 'x', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)
})

-Winston
